Name: Cult Of The Lamb Expansion Pack By Jukie1
Author: jukie1
Description:
Adds Cult Of The Lamb Stuff - Now It is going to be an expansion! (WIP)

[size=5]Alternative textures[/size]

AT texture changes include:

1000 years from now, 2 textures

Scarecrow,6 textures

Rarecrow,And Deluxe Scarecrow, 5 textures

globe, 1 texture

[size=5]Jason Assets[/size]

The Traitor's Razor: A Dagger (bought from Krobus in the sewers)

The Crusader's blade: A Sword (bought from Krobus in the sewers)

The War-maker's hammer: a hammer (bought from Krobus in the sewers)

Sinful essence (Bought from Krobus in the sewers)

Sin Fruit (grows from "sinful essence")

A Hat that you can buy from the hat mouse

[size=5]Calcifer Features[/size]
[size=3]
Adds the ability to obtain the Furniture through the cult catalogue

[/size][size=5]Content Patcher

[/size][size=3]An Npc That is in the works!

Dga Furniture has been converted to content patcher (Note the Migrate DGA items mod does not work with this because I changed somestuff like the name)

[/size][size=6]And More To Come![/size]

removed lamby (because I am doing other things at the moment)
